claims.statement: EU WEEE law includes photovoltaic panels and requires producers to bear defined collection, treatment, recovery, and environmentally sound disposal costs for relevant electrical equipment.
Poland's BDO system provides electronic waste records and reporting, and its public register lets businesses check the declared legal activity of collectors, transporters, and processors.
The official Polish waste-transfer-card format records approval, transport confirmation, waste takeover, mass, and timestamps, providing candidate release events for a recycling receipt.

contrary_evidence: Collective producer-responsibility schemes already pool compliance and recycling funding, potentially making a new per-serial layer redundant.
A present-day reserve for an event decades away may be unattractive unless it solves a current compliance, financing, or asset-transfer need.

economics.acquisition_route: A distributor or producer-responsibility pilot combined with one licensed recycler and a small installer group
economics.founder_net_worth_path: A plausible 6-8 year route would require around one million annual panel registrations across several distributors at about 6 PLN average platform revenue, recurring lifecycle services, credible long-term governance, and substantial founder ownership
economics.founder_time: Approximately 12-16 hours per week if physical logistics, waste treatment, legal compliance, and reserve custody remain with licensed partners
economics.gross_margin_basis: Registry, compliance, and orchestration revenue less identity, record integration, long-term storage, customer support, and partner fees; reserved treatment funds are not startup revenue
economics.payback: Customers must value lower compliance administration, traceable reserves, or predictable decommissioning cost; a pilot should compare total per-panel cost with existing collective schemes
economics.pricing: Target 5-12 PLN administration revenue per registered panel plus contracted logistics and recycling charges passed through to reserve or producer-responsibility partners
economics.retention_or_repeat: Importers register every shipment, asset owners transfer records, and eventual recovery events close the lifecycle

fingerprint.compounding_advantage: A long-lived installed-base registry with ownership, location, deinstallation, transport, treatment, and recovery outcomes could lower reverse-logistics cost and forecast regional panel flows
fingerprint.customer: PV panel importers, distributors, producer-responsibility organisations, large installers, asset owners, and decommissioning firms in Poland
fingerprint.distribution_mechanism: Use the family installer network for process discovery, then partner with distributors, producer-responsibility organisations, insurers, and licensed PV recyclers
fingerprint.offer_and_business_model: Serial registry, reserve receipt, owner transfer, deinstallation booking, licensed-operator verification, BDO evidence mapping, and producer compliance export
fingerprint.payer_and_paid_event: The importer or distributor pays an administration fee per registered panel and passes a recycling reserve to a licensed partner; the recycler and logistics provider are paid when BDO-backed handoff or treatment events verify performance
fingerprint.problem_trigger: A panel is placed on the market or later removed, while funding responsibility, equipment identity, lawful waste handoff, and evidence of treatment sit in separate systems and years apart

founder_fit: The family renewable business offers practical access to installation and deinstallation records
Lifecycle forecasting and record linkage fit the founder's data-science strengths
A partner network avoids owning recycling plants or tying up the founder's capital in reserves
risks: Long-duration reserves create governance, insolvency, and custody complexity
Serials may be unavailable or unreliable on older installations
Existing collective compliance schemes may already solve the producer's obligation cheaply
Waste status, transport, and treatment must be handled only by properly authorised parties

structure.commercial_archetype: Per-unit compliance reserve and reverse-logistics network
structure.control_point: The serial-linked reserve ledger and verified BDO transfer or treatment event that authorises recycler and logistics payment
structure.critical_dependency: A lawful structure with producer-responsibility organisations, long-duration reserve custody, and licensed waste operators whose records can be linked to equipment serials

thesis: Photovoltaic importers, distributors, and large installers could attach a serial-level circularity receipt and partner-held recycling reserve to panels placed on the Polish market. At deinstallation, a licensed waste operator's BDO transfer and treatment confirmation would trigger payment and close the producer or service obligation, creating an auditable bridge between today's per-unit funding and a distant recovery event.
title: PV Circularity Reserve
uncertainties: Whether Polish producer-responsibility rules permit a serial-level supplemental reserve structure
Availability of BDO interfaces or lawful exports for automatic receipt matching
Timing and regional volume of PV deinstallations in the first years
